name: DJ Symphonic & Royal Film Concert Orchestra
description: DJ Symphonic combines a symphony orchestra and a DJ to perform themes from artists like Coldplay, Daft Punk, and Queen, along with Hans Zimmer. The Royal Film Concert Orchestra, composed of over 60 musicians, performs this fusion of symphonic and electronic music.
longDescription:
DJ Symphonic is a concert featuring a symphony orchestra and a DJ, performing hits from Coldplay, Daft Punk, Queen, and Hans Zimmer, among others. This event offers an original fusion of symphonic and electronic music, transforming orchestral pieces into an energetic and emotional experience.

The Royal Film Concert Orchestra, made up of over 60 professional musicians from top European orchestras, performs this program. The orchestra is known for interpreting film music and other styles, and belongs to "Excelentia."

The program includes tracks such as Avicii's "Wake Me Up," Queen's "We Will Rock You," Daft Punk's "One More Time," and Hans Zimmer's "Now We Are Free remix." Tickets range from €45 to €300, with various seating options available at Coliseu Porto Ageas on November 22, 2026, at 21:00.

A Royal Film Concert Orchestra, composta por mais de 60 músicos profissionais das melhores orquestras europeias, apresenta este programa. A orquestra é conhecida por interpretar música de filmes e outros estilos, e pertence à "Excelentia".

O programa inclui temas como "Wake Me Up" dos Avicii, "We Will Rock You" dos Queen, "One More Time" dos Daft Punk e o "Now We Are Free remix" de Hans Zimmer. Os bilhetes variam entre 45€ e 300€, com várias opções de lugares disponíveis no Coliseu Porto Ageas a 22 de novembro de 2026, às 21:00.
